task.title: Compare pages in tabs, windows, and sessions

step.cmd: Click the Open child in new tab link. The child page opens in a new tab.
In the newest tab, check that the page reads "PAGE linked".
In a new tab named report, load the report page. Then load the scratch page in another new tab.
Check that the report tab reads "PAGE report", and that the tab showing the scratch page reads "PAGE scratch".
In a new window named settings, with its first tab named general, load the settings page. Then load the help page in another new window.
Check that the settings window and its general tab read "PAGE settings", and that the newest window, titled "Child help", reads "PAGE help".
In the first window, check that the tab titled "Multi-tab home" still reads "MULTI-TAB HOME".
Type hello in the echo box of the help window, which is also the newest window, and of the child tab, the second tab opened.
Load the notes page in a new tab named notes, and the about page in a new window named about. Check that each one reads its page name.
Start two more Firefox sessions: reviewer, with an 800 by 600 viewport, and editor, with a 1024 by 768 window. Load the review page in reviewer.
In the first session, go back to the multi-tab page, and check that it reads "MULTI-TAB HOME".
Close the report and notes tabs, the scratch tab, the child tab, the help, settings, and about windows, and the reviewer and editor sessions.
